name: intent_record
description: Record a caller-asserted Codex session intent and return required criteria and the current bounded control, if any. This source is never treated as a trusted Claude hook prompt.

prompt_id.description: Optional stable identity for replaying the same caller-asserted prompt.

name: intent_apply
description: Apply a caller-asserted proposal for this project. Advisory only. A discussion proposal records intent without activating or changing a task.

contract.description: Required for start and revise; uses the standard task contract shape.

name: task_start
description: Activate one explicitly shared worktree task from a contract. Returns a generated task_id distinct from contract id. Refuses an existing task; use supervisor task next for rollover and supervisor task deactivate to return inactive. Receipts remain caller-asserted.

event_id.description: Unique task-start event identity; an identical replay does not create another task.

command.description: The command a receipt for this criterion must cite, or a list of accepted commands. Matched exactly after trimming.

forbidden_effects.description: Declared only; the gate does not enforce it.

scope.description: Path prefixes the candidate may change.

name: candidate_observe
description: Report the candidate under test; omit the identity to let the gate derive it from git. Without base_commit and dirty_digest the gate reads the project's git state the same way its hooks do, and takes the changed paths from git unless changed_paths is given. With them, the identity and changed_paths are caller-asserted. A new identity marks every earlier receipt stale. In state repairing this also ends the repair round and returns the task to verifying.

task_id.description: Generated active task identity returned by task_start or task_state. Required for active-task mutations; old-task identities are refused.

event_id.description: Unique operation identity; replay of identical input and current evidence is idempotent.

provenance.description: Who observed the candidate; default git when derived, mcp-caller when given.

name: receipt_record
description: Record one check result for a criterion, bound to the current candidate. The command must be one the contract names for that criterion (exact text after trimming); any other command is refused. Call candidate_observe first, with no command run in between, or the receipt is refused as not observed. Caller-asserted: the server does not observe the command, and the receipt is stored and journaled as mcp-asserted.

task_id.description: Generated active task identity returned by task_start or task_state. Required for active-task mutations; old-task identities are refused.

event_id.description: Unique operation identity; replay of identical input and current evidence is idempotent.

name: finding_raise
description: Raise an open finding against the current candidate. An open high or critical finding refuses acceptance.

task_id.description: Generated active task identity returned by task_start or task_state. Required for active-task mutations; old-task identities are refused.

event_id.description: Unique operation identity; replay of identical input and current evidence is idempotent.

name: repair_request
description: Spend one repair round and move the task to repairing. When the budget is already spent the task becomes budget_exhausted and the request is refused.

task_id.description: Generated active task identity returned by task_start or task_state. Required for active-task mutations; old-task identities are refused.

event_id.description: Unique operation identity; replay of identical input and current evidence is idempotent.

name: accept_try
description: Ask the gate to accept the current candidate: every mandatory criterion needs a current receipt with exit 0, every changed path must be in scope, and no high or critical finding may be open. On success the task is ready_for_review.

task_id.description: Generated active task identity returned by task_start or task_state. Required for active-task mutations; old-task identities are refused.

event_id.description: Unique operation identity; replay of identical input and current evidence is idempotent.

name: task_complete
description: Complete a task that is ready_for_review; the gate checks the evidence again first.

task_id.description: Generated active task identity returned by task_start or task_state. Required for active-task mutations; old-task identities are refused.

event_id.description: Unique operation identity; replay of identical input and current evidence is idempotent.

name: task_state
description: Return the checkpoint, criteria, receipt status, rejected claims, paused state and pending job recovery identifiers with original task/session/worktree/candidate linkage. Pending or invalidated jobs are not successful evidence. No transition.
